{{Quote|My name is, as you know, Shohta Laar. I am trained to be a personal attandant. I cook, clean, manage personal affairs such as errands and schedules, and conduct interviews of other slaves you might desire to purchase&hellip;among other things.|Shohta Laar|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>}}
'''Shohta Laar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chev]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] of [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] regular [[Guumak]] on [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]]. In [[44 ABY]], he was bet in a drinking game by Guumak, who lost him to [[Madhi Vaandt]]. Vaandt then freed Laar and hired him as part of her [[Journalist/Legends|reporting]] crew.
During the massacre on [[Blaudu Sextus]] in [[44 ABY]], he disobeyed the instruction of [[Madhi Vaandt]] and assisted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Sothais Saar]] and [[Avinoam Arelis]] in the arrest of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] commander [[Belok Rhal]].
